title: Write-tool contract in docs/DESIGN.md
goal: The write tools, their arguments, idempotency and refusals are written before code
acceptance: Owner decision 2026-11-26 in chat: "yes to both": adding places to Hobo trips by chat ("aggiungi Rocca Calascio al trip di agosto") via MCP behind NERV's approval; and the owner's idea the same day to set an image on a Hobo place from NERV chat (nerv:F-143). Italian is required for every model-facing feature.

docs/DESIGN.md, NERV section: hobo_find_place (read-only: name → geocoded candidates with name, address, lat, lon, provider id), hobo_add_place_to_trip (tripId, a candidate or an existing placeId, optional day, requestId) and hobo_set_place_image (placeId, image as base64 bytes or an https URL, attribution {source, licence, author, url}, requestId)

Both write tools are annotated readOnlyHint false and say "CHANGES DATA" so NERV's gate asks the owner first; a repeated requestId returns the first result and writes nothing; validation errors name the field
The contract row "Item image attach" in coordinator docs/DOMAINS.md points here
privacy: Invented places, trips and images only; no API keys, tokens or personal data in Git.
escalation: Material scope growth or effort increase goes to the owner before adoption

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-26 at agent speed: one contract section next to F-011-T01's read-tool table. Not a measurement.
